background_rationale: A Nationwide lifer since 1986 who ran its property & casualty and financial services businesses as president and COO before becoming CEO.

notable.summary: Nationwide completed its $1.25 billion acquisition of Allstate's employer stop loss business, creating a new Group Benefits segment.
Nationwide acquired the renewal rights to Markel's roughly $1.2 billion global reinsurance business.
Marking Nationwide's 100th anniversary, Walker wrote that "we're not an insurance or financial services company — we're a protection company."

personal_story.hook: Raised on an Iowa Century Farm, Kirt Walker joined Nationwide in 1986 and stayed 33 years before becoming CEO.
personal_story.summary: Walker is a native of Irvington, Iowa, and was raised on a Century Farm. He earned a management degree from Iowa State University and joined the Nationwide family of companies in 1986. He spent 23 years in property and casualty leadership roles, including president of Allied Insurance and president and COO of Nationwide Insurance, then a decade as president and COO of Nationwide Financial before being elected CEO in 2019.
